status: PLAN ONLY; no implementation or candidate trial performed
scope: Plan the smallest guarded reuse for the three actual X-seam ART HOLDs. Codec migration is separate.

decision.recommendation: Allow one source-bound X-only transpose/operator/transpose-back candidate per texture after independent public and code qualification. Retain all current HOLDs until actual art review.
decision.whyNewAdapter: The existing Y main hardcodes the Y operation, axes and producer witness. A transposed input package cannot replay the actual original master. A new narrow entry point reuses the existing operator and producer functions without patching pinned tools.
decision.operation: correctedRGB = transpose(periodic_y(transpose(exactReplayedRGB)).image); transpose is axis permutation, not resampling.
limitations: Intensity correction does not align fracture endpoints, mineral shapes or ledge geometry. Lower edge MAE does not clear a fine feature phase cut.
X forcing produces a global field. Native Y joints, corners and the wwall upper X joint are not mathematically guaranteed unchanged.
Adjacent periodic pixels need not be equal. There is no first/last pixel identity criterion.
Do not retry with amplitude parameters, masking, warping, strip cloning, invented joints, edge bands, strict projection or new generation within this plan.

rejectedAlternatives.patchExistingY: Changes sealed producer hashes and broadens the increment.
rejectedAlternatives.transposeSourcePackageOrMonkeypatchYmain: Breaks actual source/master replay or writes misleading producer/axis metadata.
rejectedAlternatives.edgeAnchor: One-native-texel band and mean-colour anchoring do not fix the actual feature cut and are outside this chosen repair.
rejectedAlternatives.strictMode: Abandons the accepted photographic form policy.
rejectedAlternatives.landmarkWarp: Moves forms without demonstrated source-bound registration authority.
rejectedAlternatives.motifOrLayeredRepair: Address different defects and do not replace boundary registration.

recipeBinding: Native identity, name, edition and native dimensions.
Exact source master package path and SHA-256.
Explicit independent source/master-only proof path and SHA-256.
proofRequirements: Explicit source/master-only scope. A PASS for replay is not art acceptance.
Exactly one material row matches native identity, name, edition, master package path and SHA-256, and original/raw/prompt/RGB/float-height identities.
Current heterogeneous native and replay reports are supporting evidence. Do not silently treat them as the required new binding schema.
Never fabricate art PASS to satisfy a guard.
inputGuards: Fresh nonsymlink destination. Preserve existing ordinary file, directory, dangling symlink and all inputs.
Bounded bytes and pixels, distinct resolved input paths, canonical color.png and height.npy.
Single unrevised 8x photographic package, comparison divisor 2, edgeAnchor false, integer generationCount 1.
Reject periodicBoundary, masterRevision, motif or layered authoring markers, including empty ones.
Original/raw dimensions, adequate 8x aspect, lossless RGB PNG, nonempty bounded UTF-8 prompt.
Strict finite float32 NPY shape/range/C order, no extra or trailing bytes and no pickles.
Recorded source and tool path/hash matches. Imported operator must belong to the expected module with the pinned hash.
Replay old RGB exactly and old float-height NPY bytes exactly using recorded photographic settings, landmarks if any, and profile.
Recheck watched inputs during reading, before writing and before sealing. Never rewrite old receipts when tool drift occurs.
successor: Fresh color.png, height.npy and master.json only. Retain prior candidate outputs.
Apply unchanged periodic_y on transposed verified RGB, then transpose back, without another art transform.
Author new scalar height once from corrected RGB in original orientation with the same profile. No compressed data or stale height reuse.
Record source/old package/RGB/height identities, no additional generation, X axes, operator and adapter producer hashes, and actual environment.
Recompute edge, distance and clipping diagnostics in original orientation. Do not write transposed X/Y labels.
Mark the successor unqualified pending independent art and public review.

publicVerification.oracle: Independently reconstruct the X Poisson solution without importing the new adapter or periodic_y as the expected result. Verify the discrete Laplacian residual, zero DC, exact RGB and new height NPY.
positiveFixtures: X-only mismatch with distinct Y courses.
Geometric phase cut that remains despite improved edge MAE: must not be automatically qualified.
negativeFixtures: Changed source, proof, recipe or producer bytes.
Missing, redirected or wrong operator module.
Wrong native, material or master binding.
Trailing, nonfinite, Fortran-order or wrong-dtype NPY.
Rehashed but non-replaying RGB or height.
Existing file, directory or dangling-symlink destination.
publicVerification.rejectionContract: Normal nonzero exit; preserve inputs; no candidate output. Signal or timeout is not an expected rejection.
publicVerification.evidence: Retain RED/GREEN public CLI receipts, independent code review and failed cases. Do not weaken a maintained gate.

actualTrialGates: Inspect corrected RGB before tier export. Preserve photographic material, natural grain, coarse palette and stone forms.

Record separate negative/overflow counts and locations, mean/max correction, post-rounding means and clipped masks. Visible clipping, halos, bands or destroyed detail fail without a percentage-tolerance escape.
Inspect new full-precision height and actual face/joint witnesses, both axes, corners, XYZ and opposed lights before encoding. Retain failed witnesses.
Derive new Mid 4x and High 8x directly from the same corrected RGB/float master through qualified role-aware export.
Colour Q92/method 6; height, XYZ and qualified masks lossless/method 6. Explicit quantization and exact decoded data review remain required.
Independently view actual both-tier 1:1, repeats, X/Y strips, rolled corners, BOX native/2 and native/4 on BOTH inputs, relief/opposed lights and old/new/native comparisons.
All observed X cutoffs must cease to read as discontinuities, without invented geometry, noise or lost native joints. Otherwise retain HOLD.
